constraints: Private networking (AWS PrivateLink) requires the Scale plan. This org is on Free, so no project has a private endpoint.
Neon compute endpoint ids (ep-...) are not AWS VPC endpoint ids (vpce-...); infra-isolation/contract.json wants the latter.
Neon suspension alone can wake on traffic. A paused fleet must also show autoResume=false.
A VPC is regional. Neon is us-east-1 and Supabase is us-east-2, so they cannot share one literal VPC; see infra-isolation/README.md.
